mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_local_message (exchange, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count) VALUES (#{exchange}, #{routingKey}, #{payload}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, exchange, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count, create_time, update_time FROM mall_local_message WHERE status = 0 AND retry_count < 5 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_local_message SET status = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mall_local_message SET retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
